title: Alert deduplication
summary: Detect whether two alerts describe the same incident.
why: The system needs a grouping signal, not two generated summaries.

same.instructions: Do both alerts describe the same service failure and symptom?

state.a: API database connection refused on primary.
state.b: Primary DB refusing connections; API requests fail.

limitation: Synthetic examples demonstrate an integration pattern. Validate on representative labeled data before choosing a model or an operating threshold.
